rows.en:
(Claire-senpai is all smiles today.
I wonder if something good happened?)
You're in a good mood, Claire-senpai.

Well, the movie was fun,
and the tea is delicious too.
Last time was a total disaster, after all.
rows.notes: Refers to frd_cla_005 (the outing went wrong).

rows.en: Don't bring that up!

Oh-ho? \p!
And Claire-senpai too!

Hm?
Hoshimura? What are you doing in a place like this?

I got hungry, so I came to buy maguro buns.
The ones here are sooo deee-licious, y'know!

They really are good, huh.
I mean to grab a quick bite, but I end up
eating a whole bunch.
Yup, yup, that's just how it is!

These things, y'know? There's gotta be
something inside 'em that makes you
eat a bunch. For sure.
I know, I know.
Right? Right!?
Ahem!!
Claire-senpai, is something wrong?

A bit of maguro bun just got stuck
in my throat, that's all.
rows.notes: Claire switches to stiff polite form (desu): a pointed excuse.

rows.en:
That's no good~
You've gotta chew properly!

Aren't you the one who's always
telling me that?
rows.notes: Male only. Direction: Claire is always warning the player (to chew properly).

rows.en:
You're always getting scolded
about stuff like that!?
Claire-senpai's just like a mom!
H-hey, Hoshimura...

Oh, looks like my maguro buns are ready.
Well, see ya~!
Um, well...
You and Yui-chan seem close.

Huh? You think so?
I'd say we're just... normal, though...

I guess you'd rather hang out with someone
your own age after all...
rows.notes: Shared by both genders: kept neutral.

rows.en: Shall we get going too?

(She was so cheerful until a minute ago...
What's gotten into Claire-senpai?)

I had fun today.
Let's go out again sometime.
Yes, I'll get in touch!
Okay, I'll be waiting.

(Ah, she's gone...
She stayed down right to the very end...)

(Claire-senpai seems to be in a good mood
all day today. I wonder if something good
happened?)

Oh-ho? \p-cchi!
And Claire-senpai too!
rows.notes: Female only. Yui's cutesy nickname suffix -cchi kept like an honorific (no precedent in finished slices).

rows.en:
Oh, Yui!
What are you doing here?

Yeah, yeah, they're so good~
I mean to grab a quick bite,
but I always end up having a bunch more.

Yeah, yeah!
They're totally addictive!

Aren't you the one who's always
telling me that?
rows.notes: Female only; same as the male line c04547.

rows.en: Y-Yui!
Okay, I'll get in touch.
(Nyan-Nyan's uniforms really are cute...)

What's with that face?
Ogling them like that...
rows.notes: Hana no shita wo nobasu (ogling). Shared by both genders.

rows.en: Huh! N-no, it's n-nothing...!

I bet you were thinking the Nyan-Nyan
waitresses are cuter than someone like me
anyway, weren't you?
rows.notes: Tenin-san = shop staff; 'waitresses' inferred from the cute uniform the player was admiring.

rows.en: Th-there's no way I'd think that, honestly...!
Yeah, right...
Cl-Claire-senpai~
Hmph! Not listening!
rows.notes: Tsuun: turning up her nose in a sulk.

rows.en: Th-the maguro buns were good, weren't they...?

Were they...?
I liked the sesame balls better.
...O-oh, okay...
Hmph!
rows.notes: x6: Claire here, Alto in nml_alt_018/020.

rows.en: C-come on, please don't be mad...
I'm not angry or anything!
(She's totally furious...)
(...Ugh, this is embarrassing, but...)

...Y-you're way prettier, Senpai.
I'm always captivated by you.
...O-oh, is that so...
Heh~ I see, I see...
(Oh, she's in a good mood again.)
Well then, see you later!
rows.notes: x4: Claire here, Ranka in frd_rnk_008. Consistent with c01557.

rows.en:
(Ah, she's gone...
Maybe Senpai was embarrassed too?)
I'm NOT angry at all!
(She's totally furious...)
rows.notes: Female only; the Japanese is polite in the monologue, no effect in English.

rows.en:
...Y-you're way prettier, Senpai!
I'm always admiring you!

uncertain: c04564: player name + cchi nickname suffix rendered '\p-cchi' (Yui's cutesy suffix kept like an honorific; no precedent found)
c04574: tenin-san rendered 'waitresses' (inferred from the Nyan-Nyan uniform)
